brief:
Israelis have voted against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in five separate elections, according to Ma'an news agency, yet Arab states, organizations, and media outlets have supported his political survival and leadership. The contrast reflects a divide between Israeli public opinion and regional actors' stance toward Netanyahu's continued rule.

Netanyahu has faced repeated rejection at the ballot box despite backing from certain Arab governments and entities that have maintained or developed ties with his administration.
title: Israeli voters rejected Netanyahu five times while Arabs and organizations backed him
